mechanism_summary: Pre-register BTCUSD-equivalent BB-width squeeze volatility breakout screening before WFA execution.
instrument_scope: BTCUSD-equivalent 1h crypto CFD hypothesis using Binance BTCUSDT proxy research data; FTMO/MT5-listed by terminal universe evidence, research-only until MT5 data equivalence is proven.
expected_trade_frequency: Medium-to-high frequency; no low-frequency exception is registered and the default 200-trade floor applies.
data_sources: FTMO terminal universe snapshot lists BTCUSD, but MT5 data equivalence is not assumed.
cost_assumptions: Use only bb_width_squeeze WFA config costs: fees 0.0006 and slippage 0.0002, no hidden overrides.

wfa_design.window_policy: Use the canonical 3m training / 1m testing / 1m step WFA scheme encoded in the Phase 8D runtime-feasibility config.
wfa_design.optimizer_policy: Use the preregistered 25-trial runtime-feasibility route and count this repaired attempt in the denominator.
wfa_design.repair_rationale: Pre-result mechanical runtime repair: original Phase 8D BTC BB squeeze attempt RUN-PHASE8D-BTC-BB-SQUEEZE-20260530215722 timed out after 1800000ms with accepted_output_count=0 and no artifact-backed WFA metrics, so this new denominator attempt keeps the same hypothesis/source/data/costs but uses a Phase 8D-specific 25-trial WFA config to complete within the worker budget.

invalidation_criteria: Reject as non-survivor if real WFA fails any Phase 8D survivor floor on completed OOS windows, total trades, return proxy, or positive OOS window ratio.
Reject any deployment or Phase 8E implication unless a separate survivor exists with MT5 instrument equivalence and explicit operator authorization.
Treat any post-result change to symbol, timeframe, cost, parameter space, data source, or WFA config as a new denominator-tracked attempt.
